name: How does a design-build approach benefit ground-up construction?

mainEntity.name: How does a design-build approach benefit ground-up construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design-build keeps design, pricing, and construction under one team, which helps control cost and schedule, improves constructability, and reduces gaps between the architect and contractor. midconstruction+2
